name: Fuzzytongue penstemon
desc: Fuzzytongue penstemon (Penstemon eriantherus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Penstemon eriantherus is a species of flowering plant in the plantain family known by the common names fuzzytongue penstemon and crested penstemon.
